contracts.docstring: Identify an actual retained job; all output, origin and authority are resolved by the host.
Capture only actual complete command bytes in the current author scope, never output submitted by the model.

Handles task_available and task_resume events.

Dispatches to DevelopmentFlow or ResearchFlow based on task type.
Acknowledge owner-managed task hints without claiming them; dispatch remaining legacy tasks.
Orchestrates the complete project lifecycle using event-driven flows.
Run a sub-flow in a background thread and signal completion.
Resolve an old scientific entry to the actual scoped owner workspace without selecting agents or executing a legacy stage.
Retain historical state shape without initializing CrewAI, services or a model loop.
Return original native references or explicit owner admission; old review/revision labels confer no authority.
Resolve an old scientific entry to the actual scoped owner workspace without selecting agents or executing a legacy stage.
Retain historical state shape without initializing CrewAI, services or a model loop.
Return original native references or explicit owner admission; old review/revision labels confer no authority.
Compatibility snapshot of the retired scientific author flow; historical hypotheses, scores and report metadata never authorize native execution or acceptance.
Compatibility snapshot for the exploratory owner handoff; historical fields do not start a model stage or grant authority.
Compatibility snapshot of retired review/revision routing; stored labels and retry counts cannot validate findings, resume work or accept a native result.
Atomically capture only this current native author's closed terminal job, retaining failures/truncation and refusing binary or incomplete output.
Resolve actual stored origin/closure and create the document with the same source/receipt transaction.
Own scoped source/finding/report/wiki transactions, revocable grants and atomic effect receipts.
Insert one exact captured document inside the caller's already-authorized source/receipt transaction.
Persist captured document and original receipt together; ordinary capture intent remains compatible.
Capture this native author's actual closed terminal command output as exact citable evidence without replaying work.
One canonical signature/schema and HTTP mapping for either transport.
Translate host-owned business tools to scoped HTTP without owning grants or inference.

Capture this author attempt's retained terminal and physically closed command stdout/stderr as exact cited source text. Supply the actual job_id only; the host resolves bytes/origin/closure. Failed exits/truncation remain explicit limits; binary or incomplete output is refused. Capture neither reruns the command nor validates its scientific conclusion; preserve operation_key on retry.
Refuse legacy mutation/inference for migrated documentary/scientific work and any task with native admission history.
Build subscription-only sessions with required Ken and host-owned private development views.
Admit one original project attempt with required Ken and revocable peers.
Own durable admission, fenced attempts and version-bound review requests in SQLite.
Atomically freeze host input and reserve its one non-replayable turn.
Migrated scientific tasks must not be rediscovered as legacy worker events.
Retain pending scientific work without emitting a legacy claim event.
A historical rejection does not authorize an automatic scientific rework.
Research review needs exact native owner admission rather than a role scavenger hint.
A review_ready task is not a versioned independent review request.
Old hypothesis/confidence fields remain attributed history; loading them starts no stage or validation.
Research/review entry reads the real project/task and never claims, revises, reviews or completes from old labels.
Missing, foreign or coerced identifiers cannot select a convenient project or trigger old inference.
Advance controlled author or reviewer generation while using the real admitted tool bridge.
End the controlled protocol with an explicitly limited research or review candidate.
Exercise actual source/job capture, competing hypotheses, experiment, synthesis and wiki through native host tools; generation is scripted.
Inspect the author's exact finding and both retained sources through an independently admitted review-only session.
Normal startup installs the typed publication schema, keeps accepted provenance and prevents retargeting its immutable original request.
A documentary handoff must not be rediscovered as missing legacy work indefinitely.
A failed schema52 install rolls back its table/guards; a repeatable successful upgrade preserves actual schema51 historical records.
Prepare exactly schema51 without changing any historical migration resource.

One owner execution dispatches planner, author and developer, plus a separate exact-subject reviewer for the scientific case; only explicit research acceptance releases the dependent and no code is accepted or published.
A failed migration cannot leave rebuilt half-tables; upgrading an actual schema49 preserves original identities and exact handoff bytes.
Prepare the real pre-upgrade schema without modifying its historical SQL resources.
A failed schema51 install cannot change existing manifests or replace the old invalidation view; successful retry retains exact original intent and foreign keys.
Prepare the actual schema50 while leaving its historical SQL resources unchanged.
An old public entry preserves the original native author and exposes only an owner hint, without another inference, claim or acceptance.
Bind one current native researcher and original tool scope without invoking a model.
Insert an explicitly synthetic command receipt linked to an actual registered fixture peer.
A retained job's exact stdout becomes cited experimental evidence, not a model-supplied transcript or confidence score.
A terminal-looking row is insufficient while its peer remains open, output is binary, or dispatch outcome is unknown.
A closed failing/truncated experiment can be retained as limited evidence, with all failure flags visible.
Even a queued scientific review/revision must not restart old inference or complete work after a retry limit.
A current author cannot borrow another task's actual job, and an unbound broad grant cannot substitute for an admitted author.
A lost capture reply can recover only its original job/source, never a new experiment under the same key.
Old hints cannot select a scientific worker, use a review label as authority or complete best-effort work.
Historical research remains readable, while a new raw legacy claim/completion requires native admission/acceptance.
A failed schema53 install leaves schema52 data/guards intact; a repeatable retry preserves historical scientific completion without inventing acceptance.
Prepare exactly the prior schema, without editing historical migration SQL.

Run pending schema migrations for existing databases.

Checks the ``schema_migrations`` table and applies any missing
migrations. Safe to call multiple times. Serving requires an already
initialized file; explicit installation/legacy callers may create one.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
